id: Mewtwo: Who are you to intrude on my home? These Pokémon have been abused in the past and deserve to be left in peace.
en: Mewtwo: Who are you to intrude on my home? These Pokémon have been abused in the past and deserve to be left in peace.
it: Mewtwo: Chi siete voi per invadere la mia casa? Questi Pokémon hanno subito maltrattamenti in passato e meritano di essere lasciati in pace.

id: You came here looking for the source of my creation. Your friend wishes to obtain every Pokémon. You wish to become the strongest.
en: You came here looking for the source of my creation. Your friend wishes to obtain every Pokémon. You wish to become the strongest.
it: Siete venuti qui in cerca dell'origine della mia creazione. Il tuo amico desidera ottenere ogni Pokémon. Tu desideri diventare il più forte.

id: I have tested his resolve. Now let me see yours.
en: I have tested his resolve. Now let me see yours.
it: Ho messo alla prova la sua determinazione. Ora fammi vedere la tua.

id: Mewtwo: You have both done well. You dedicate yourself to your dreams despite the difficult challenges they bring. I wish you luck.
en: Mewtwo: You have both done well. You dedicate yourself to your dreams despite the difficult challenges they bring. I wish you luck.
it: Mewtwo: Siete stati entrambi bravi. Vi dedicate ai vostri sogni nonostante le difficili sfide che comportano. Vi auguro buona fortuna.

id: However, this place is not for you. Let me return you to your homes.
en: However, this place is not for you. Let me return you to your homes.
it: Tuttavia, questo luogo non fa per voi. Lasciate che vi riporti alle vostre case.
